name: Shimotsuki Miyo
source: The youngest of the three sisters. A very caring girl who is a master at cooking and cleaning, and has even said that her sisters can't do anything without her. Similarly to her sisters despite the fact that she was almost sold out due to their father's debt, she manages to stay positive. Despite her proficiency at household chores Miyo does things at her own pace.
